```plato
//==
// # IGeometry
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - IFitted primitives
//  - Convex hulls

//==
// # IFitted primitives
//
// The results of fitting a primitive shape to a set of sample points: the
// recovered shape paired with a record of how well it matches. Fitting is a
// numerical estimation this vocabulary does not perform — these are the shapes
// such an estimator returns, so that a caller reading a fit always finds the
// residual statistics beside the shape rather than losing them at the API seam.
//
// Every fit reports its quality through the same FitQuality record, so a
// tolerance check reads the same way whatever was fitted.

// How closely a fitted shape matches the samples it was fitted to: the
// root-mean-square of the point-to-shape distances, the largest single such
// distance, and how many samples stand behind both. All distances are
// non-negative and in coordinate units; MaximumError is never less than
// RootMeanSquareError.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Root-mean-square_deviation)
type FitQuality
    implements IValue
{
    RootMeanSquareError: Number;
    MaximumError: Number;
    SampleCount: Integer;
}
```
